config._comment_slot: Logical replication slot + pgoutput plugin (WAL-based CDC).
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: mosaic_slot
config.publication.name: mosaic_pub
config._comment_signal: Ad-hoc snapshots: python mosaic.py resnapshot (tools/cdc/snapshot.py). Needed because Kafka retention can delete the initial snapshot before Bronze lands it -- CHANGES-FROM-GR1 A10. Kafka channel rather than a signalling table, so nothing new has to be added to mosaic_pub (finding A9 is what happens when the publication and the connector disagree).
config._comment_wal: WAL accumulation guard (GR1 section 4.4 / Table 4.3). The heartbeat writes to a table inside the publication so that confirmed_flush_lsn advances even when the monitored tables are idle -- without this, an idle period looks identical to a stalled consumer and WAL grows unbounded.
config._comment_wal_measured: public.cdc_heartbeat must appear in table.include.list AND in mosaic_pub, or the guard above is inert. M2 measured it: with the heartbeat table outside the publication, 130 s of idle with a healthy connector advanced current_wal_lsn 0/4175C28 -> 0/4176308 while confirmed_flush_lsn stayed at 0/40D3EA8. pgoutput decodes only published tables, so the heartbeat INSERT wrote WAL that Debezium never saw and therefore could never acknowledge. Verify with: python mosaic.py wal-guard
config._comment_masking: Layer-1 PII masking at the connector, not via SMT. See docs/adr/0004-connector-native-masking.md. national_id is excluded outright rather than hashed: GR1 Appendix A says it must never be persisted, and a salted hash is still persistence.
config._comment_envelope: No ExtractNewRecordState here -- Bronze keeps the full envelope per GR1 section 4.2.
config._comment_converter: JSON rather than Avro -- see docs/adr/0005-json-converter.md. schemas.enable=false keeps the Debezium envelope (op/before/after/source) intact while dropping the per-message Connect schema block.
